footer.tagline: Leading seamless knitwear manufacturer in Shanghai, China. Over 20 years of excellence in OEM & ODM services for global brands.
footer.address: No. 351 Tahui Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai
footer.rightsReserved: Tahui Sweater Factory. All rights reserved.

home.heroSubtitle: With over 20 years of export manufacturing excellence, Tahui delivers premium seamless knitwear, multi-material collections, and advanced craftsmanship — from OEM production to full ODM development, with precision and quality.
home.collectionsSubtitle: From classic sweaters to innovative seamless garments, we manufacture a complete range of knitwear products for global fashion brands.

seamless.title: Seamless Knitwear
seamless.description: Featuring innovative seamless sweaters and base layers produced using advanced fully automatic seamless knitting technology for ultimate comfort and fit.

multiMaterial.title: Multi-Material Collection
multiMaterial.description: A wide range of premium knitwear and blankets crafted from diverse materials including wool, silk, cotton, linen, and specialized fancy yarns.

advancedCraftsmanship.title: Advanced Craftsmanship
advancedCraftsmanship.description: Showcasing our diverse processing capabilities, from jacquard and hand-knitting to embroidery, beading, and custom dyeing techniques like tie-dye and gradient.

home.strengthsSubtitle: We combine advanced technology, skilled craftsmanship, and decades of export experience to deliver exceptional knitwear for your brand.

wholegarment.title: WholeGarment Technology
wholegarment.description: Advanced seamless knitting with 200+ machines for superior comfort and minimal waste.

oemOdm.title: OEM & ODM Services
oemOdm.description: Flexible manufacturing solutions from your designs or complete product development.

globalExport.title: Global Export Experience
globalExport.description: Two decades serving international brands with reliable supply chain management.

isoCertified.title: ISO Certified Quality
isoCertified.description: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certified for consistent quality assurance.

home.manufacturingSubtitle: Our state-of-the-art facility houses over 200 WholeGarment seamless knitting machines, enabling us to produce premium knitwear with superior comfort, minimal seams, and reduced waste.
manufacturingBullets: Premium materials: wool, cotton, silk, cashmere, blends
Advanced techniques: jacquard, embroidery, hand crochet
Strict quality control at every stage

certSection.paragraph: Our commitment to quality, environmental responsibility, and workplace safety is validated by internationally recognized certifications.

factory.subtitle: Take a glimpse into our modern production facility where craftsmanship meets technology.
factory.linkingDesc: Core assembly floor where skilled artisans piece together knitwear components with precision stitching.
factory.handFinishingDesc: Detailed inspection and hand-trimming to ensure every garment meets our exacting quality standards.
factory.qualitySortingDesc: Careful piece-by-piece review and grading before garments move to finishing.
factory.steamPressingDesc: Professional steam shaping to give each garment its final silhouette and drape.
factory.packagingDesc: Carefully boxed and labeled, ready for worldwide export to our brand partners.

products.collectionsSubtitle: From seamless innovation to artisanal craft, explore our three core product lines. All items available for OEM production or full ODM development.
products.materialsSubtitle: We source the finest yarns from trusted suppliers worldwide, ensuring consistent quality and sustainable sourcing for every order.
products.oemDesc: Bring your designs to life. Provide tech packs, samples, or detailed specifications, and our team will produce your knitwear to exact requirements.
products.odmDesc: Leverage our design expertise. From trend research to sample development, our in-house team creates complete collections tailored to your brand.
products.ctaSubtitle: Contact our team to discuss your product requirements, request samples, or schedule a virtual factory tour.
products.allInCollection: All products in this collection. Available for OEM & ODM.
